name: remotion-platform
description: Production-ready Remotion video generation platform with Zod validation, dynamic metadata, audio sync, and BullMQ queue.

scripts.build: npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/promo.mp4
scripts.build:custom: npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/promo.mp4 --props
scripts.render:smoke: rm -f out/test-smoke.mp4 && npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/test-smoke.mp4 --frames=0-30
scripts.render:full: rm -f out/promo-full.mp4 && npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/promo-full.mp4
scripts.render:smoke:audio: rm -f out/test-smoke.mp4 out/test-smoke-muxed.mp4 && npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/test-smoke.mp4 --frames=0-30 && bash scripts/mux-audio.sh out/test-smoke.mp4 public/bgm/bgm.wav out/test-smoke-muxed.mp4 0.5
scripts.render:full:audio: rm -f out/promo-full.mp4 out/promo-full-muxed.mp4 && npx remotion render src/index.ts PromoVideo out/promo-full.mp4 && bash scripts/mux-audio.sh out/promo-full.mp4 public/bgm/bgm.wav out/promo-full-muxed.mp4 0.5
scripts.render:qa: npm run render:smoke && python3 scripts/review-render.py out/test-smoke.mp4 config/qa-reference.json
scripts.render:qa:full: npm run render:full && python3 scripts/review-render.py out/promo-full.mp4 config/qa-reference.json
